decisions.reason: The 2K glass flake spraying system serves a durable heavy-duty corrosion protection niche that builds on core 2K competence, so withdrawal after two years is unlikely.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established injection and construction repair business, has its own page, and costs little to maintain.
The multi-model transfer pump line supports the broad material conveying business and system sales, making an early drop improbable.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization and process-control strategy and adds value to its coating systems.
The newly launched hydraulic 2K spraying system is close to the core offer and needs time to build sales, so it will be kept.
